types.label: Hub approval and veto notices on the phone
types.description: A new call waiting on axHub (an approval, or a held call counting down) is sent once to the phone through Phone Connect; the notice opens the console's Hub → Approvals screen on that request. Deciding stays your own tap.

types.label: A session asked for a pass
types.description: A session asked for a timed pass; it waits on Hub → Passes for your Grant.
